territorial_scope.description: Applies to processing with effects in Switzerland, including acts initiated abroad, and requires foreign controllers meeting listed conditions to designate a Swiss representative.

evidence.quote: Dieses Gesetz gilt für Sachverhalte, die sich in der Schweiz auswirken, auch wenn sie im Ausland veranlasst werden.

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP), in force 1 September 2023: sets principles, duties and data-subject rights for private persons and federal bodies processing personal data, including automated individual decisions and cross-border disclosure, supervised by the EDÖB and backed by criminal fines.
summary.long: The Act protects the personality and fundamental rights of natural persons whose personal data is processed (Art. 1). It applies to private persons and federal bodies, and to matters with effects in Switzerland even if initiated abroad (Arts. 2-3). Controllers and processors must observe processing principles, privacy by design and by default, and data security duties (Arts. 6-8). Foreign controllers meeting listed conditions must designate a Swiss representative (Art. 14), and disclosure abroad requires adequate protection or listed safeguards, subject to exceptions (Arts. 16-17). Data subjects receive information duties, notice of automated individual decisions with a right to human review, and access and portability rights (Arts. 19, 21, 25, 28). High-risk processing requires a data protection impact assessment, with EDÖB consultation where residual risk remains (Arts. 22-23); security breaches are reported to the EDÖB (Art. 24). The EDÖB may investigate and order administrative measures against named controllers (Arts. 49-51). Private persons face fines up to CHF 250,000 for listed offences, prosecuted by the cantons (Arts. 60-65).

thresholds.variable_text: Anzahl Mitarbeitende des Unternehmens (weniger als 250) als Schwelle für eine Ausnahme vom Verzeichnis der Bearbeitungstätigkeiten
thresholds.measurement: Not stated in the text (headcount basis and reference period not specified)
thresholds.consequence: The Federal Council is to provide exemptions from the record-keeping duty under Art. 12 for companies below this size whose processing carries low risk.
thresholds.conditions: Processing must bring only a low risk of violations of the personality of the data subjects.

evidence.quote: Der Bundesrat sieht Ausnahmen für Unternehmen vor, die weniger als 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter beschäftigen

thresholds.variable_text: Alter der Daten (Daten nicht älter als zehn Jahre) bei der Bonitätsprüfung
thresholds.measurement: Age of the processed credit data at the time of processing; measurement method not stated
thresholds.consequence: Processing of personal data to check creditworthiness can be justified by an overriding private interest under Art. 31(2)(c).
thresholds.conditions: Data must not be sensitive personal data or high-risk profiling; data disclosed to third parties only if needed to conclude or perform a contract with the data subject; data subject must be of full age.

evidence.quote: Die Daten sind nicht älter als zehn Jahre.

thresholds.variable_text: Busse (fine) von höchstens 50 000 Franken, bei der das Absehen von der Verfolgung natürlicher Personen möglich ist
thresholds.consequence: The authority may refrain from prosecuting the persons responsible within the business and instead sentence the business operation (Geschäftsbetrieb) to pay the fine.
thresholds.conditions: Identifying the punishable persons under Art. 6 VStrR would require investigative measures disproportionate to the penalty.

evidence.quote: Fällt eine Busse von höchstens 50 000 Franken in Betracht

thresholds.variable_text: Alter des Beauftragten: Versicherung bei der Pensionskasse bis zum vollendeten 65. Altersjahr
thresholds.measurement: Age of the commissioner (Beauftragte oder Beauftragter)
thresholds.consequence: The commissioner is insured with the federal pension fund PUBLICA up to the completed 65th year; afterwards, continued pension coverage is available on request.
thresholds.conditions: Applies to the commissioner of the FDPIC (EDÖB) under Art. 43; continuation after 65 requires continued employment.

evidence.quote: bis zum vollendeten 65. Altersjahr bei der Pensionskasse des Bundes PUBLICA

thresholds.variable_text: Alter des Beauftragten: Altersvorsorge nach 65 höchstens bis zum Ende des Jahres der Vollendung des 68. Altersjahres
thresholds.value_text: höchstens aber bis zum Ende des Jahres, in dem sie oder er das 68. Altersjahr vollendet
thresholds.measurement: Age of the commissioner (Beauftragte oder Beauftragter)
thresholds.consequence: If employment continues after age 65, pension coverage on request continues until the end of employment, at most until the end of the year in which the 68th year is completed.
thresholds.conditions: Requires continuation of the employment relationship after the completed 65th year and a request by the commissioner.
